title_sq: Komuna e Parisit Prane Cristal Shitet Apar 1+1
description_sq:
Shitet Apartament 1+1 ne Komune pran Kriatalit Ideal per Investim !
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 5-te te nje pallati me ashensor dhe orientohet nga Jug-Perndimi cka i mundeson ndricim natyral gjate gjithe dites.
Organizimi i brendshem eshte si me poshte: hyrja me korridor, salloni i ndenjes me fasade xhami, nje dhome gjumi e bollshme, dhe tualeti me dritare.
Apartamenti eshte ristrukturuar se fundmi dhe eshte gati per mobilim.
title_en: Commune of Paris Near Cristal For Sale Separate 1+1
description_en: 1+1 apartment for sale in the municipality near Kriatal, ideal for investment! The apartment is located on the 5th floor of a building with an elevator and is oriented to the South-West, which allows natural lighting throughout the day. The internal organization is as follows: entrance with corridor, living room with glass facade, a spacious bedroom, and toilet with window. The apartment has been recently restructured and is ready for furnishing.
